question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "climatic."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Climatic" means connected with the climate. (जलवायु-संबंधी)

 
 
• **Example**: *Some parts of the world seem to be experiencing **climatic__** changes.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that birds may be found everywhere and in every climate zone.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

There are over 9000 species of birds on this planet __out__ of which over 1360 are found in India alone. 81 species of birds __**are**__ endemic to India. Because birds are found everywhere, and in all __**climatic**__ zones, their sizes, shapes and wings are ______ (4) ______ according to the needs of their habitat. For instance, eagles and hawks have massive soaring wings with primary feather that ______ (5) ______ out and allow them to soar high in the sky.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Administrative: **connected with the organization of a country, business, etc., and the way in which it is managed. ((देश, व्‍यापार आदि का) प्रशासन-संबंधी, संचालन-संबंधी)
 
• **Atmospheric: **connected with the earth’s atmosphere. (वायुमंडलीय)
 
• **Aerial: **a long metal stick on a building, car, etc. that receives radio or television signals. (कार या मकान पर लगी धातु की लंबी छड़ी जो रेडियो या टेलीविज़न तरंगें ग्रहण करती है; एरियल)
